# PanePilot v0.8.2

PanePilot 0.8.2 fixes interruptions during AI-assisted LaTeX editing and adds
practical proofing, auto-save, and image-preview improvements.

## Improvements and fixes

- Keep writing while an inline Codex revision runs. PanePilot tracks the requested
  range without repeatedly rescanning the manuscript, preserves unrelated typing,
  and remembers each project’s source, selection, scroll position, PDF page, and
  zoom for the current app session.
- Auto-save LaTeX source by default after a short typing pause, with an independent
  per-project toggle. Add durable proof comments to verified source selections and
  hide or reveal the Document Map and proofing margin independently. Comments stay
  in PanePilot’s local project database and do not invoke an agent.
- Hover a project-relative path inside `\includegraphics{...}` to preview the local
  or SSH image and open the exact file in Files. Supported image previews allow up
  to 5 MB; text previews remain capped at 1 MB.

## Download

The attached DMG and ZIP support Apple silicon Macs running macOS 12 or newer.
`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains SHA-256 checksums for both downloads. PanePilot has no
automatic update channel; install new versions from this repository.

PanePilot Remote for Android remains available as source under `android/`; this
release does not include a signed Android APK.

Stable latest-release link: [github.com/Salazar-Prime/PanePilot/releases/latest](https://github.com/Salazar-Prime/PanePilot/releases/latest)

## First launch

This desktop build is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized. After copying
PanePilot to Applications, Control-click it in Finder, choose **Open**, and confirm
the launch. Do not disable Gatekeeper. Download PanePilot artifacts only from this
GitHub repository.
